open_points.subject: plan_run mapped node conclusion before map list delivery
open_points.text: a mapped node whose list has not been delivered has no element, has not concluded and is not ready;
open_points.other_text: a skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed record, which runs writes only for a node none of whose elements executed, concludes the whole node so at once, mapped or not — the rule that a mapped node concludes only when every element concluded is for a node whose elements execute —,
open_points.question: Must the no-delivered-list rule exclude mapped nodes represented by skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed records, or must those records no longer conclude such mapped nodes?
